text:
Ne NFL tenant no frɛ no GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium na wɔsan too no din "Kansas City Stadium" ma 2026 FIFA World Cup no, beae no firi groundbreaking a wɔyɛe wɔ 11 July 1968. Ɛbuee wɔ 12 August 1972, ɛberɛ a Kansas City Chiefs dii St. Louis Cardinals 24–14 wɔ preseason game a ɛdi kan no mu. Wɔkyekyeree stadium no sɛ ɛyɛ Truman Sports Complex no fa, a ɛne Kauffman Stadium, MLB's Royals fie, na ɛshare.

Original design no yɛ Kansas City firm Kivett and Myers adwuma; akyiri renovation a wɔyɛe wɔ 2007 ne 2010 ntam no, Populous, a na ɛyɛ HOK Sport, na ɛyɛe, na ɛyɛ US$375 million bɛyɛ. Stadium no buee a ne capacity yɛ 78,097, a wɔde dii dwuma firi 1972 kɔsi 1994, na Chiefs-configuration capacity no agyina 76,416 firi 2010 de bɛsi nnɛ.

Beae no ayɛ Chiefs fie a ɛto so daa firi 1972, ɛma ɛyɛ one of the most established stadiums wɔ American professional sport mu. Firii 1996 kɔsi 2007 ɛsan hosting MLS charter club a na wɔfrɛ no Kansas City Wiz and Wizards, franchise a ɛbɛyɛɛ Sporting Kansas City. Ne playing surface yɛ natural NorthBridge Bermudagrass, a wɔde dii dwuma firi 2013.

Wɔ March 2021 mu no, wɔtɔɔ naming rights no ma GEHA, na ɛde official name GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium bae. Stadium no kura Guinness World Record sɛ ɛyɛ loudest crowd roar wɔ sports stadium mu, 142.2 dBA, a wɔset wɔ 29 September 2014.

Ma 2026 FIFA World Cup no, beae no hosting matches six: group-stage games four, Round of 32 tie baako, ne quarterfinal baako.
